input_types: One UTF-8 JSON object conforming to toolbox-source-section-parity-input-r0 on stdin, at most 512,000 bytes; includes caller-supplied source text, asserted source SHA-256/ref, candidate path and unique exact markers.
required_outputs: One deterministic JSON result with source/candidate document and section SHA-256 values, byte counts, byte offsets, exact-match status, and typed failure findings; no document text is returned.
